- Validate input constraints (integer 2–99); immediately return False for values < 8 (smallest product 2*2*2=8).
- Generate all primes <= a using a simple sieve or trial-division helper is_prime(n); then enumerate products of three primes with repetition (p≤q≤r) and check if any p*q*r == a.
- Optimization: early prune during enumeration when partial product exceeds a; alternatively factorize a by dividing by smallest prime factors counting prime factors with multiplicity and return True iff exactly 3 prime factors (with repetition) and remainder is 1.
